# MatrixQR

> MatrixQR is a free QR code generator that processes QR content in the browser. Generate WiFi, website URL, phone-number, and vCard QR codes without creating an account or uploading the entered QR content to a generation server.

## Official Resources

- [MatrixQR QR Code Generator](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Main browser-based QR generation tool.
- [About MatrixQR](https://www.matrixqr.cc/about): Project background and privacy approach.
- [MatrixQR Official Blog](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/): Technical explanations, guides, and privacy-related articles.
- [Digital Menu QR Tool](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Separate tool for digital menu QR workflows.

## Supported QR Types

- **WiFi**: Encodes a network name and password in a WiFi QR payload.
- **Website URL**: Encodes a web address.
- **Phone number**: Encodes a `tel:` link.
- **vCard contact**: Encodes name, organization, phone, and email fields.

## Privacy Model

- QR payload construction and QR rendering are performed locally in the browser.
- The QR content entered into the generator is not sent to a backend for QR generation.
- Do not interpret this as a guarantee that every browser extension, device, network, or other third-party software is free of tracking; use a trusted browser and device.

## Customization and Export

- Supports foreground/background color customization and QR corner-color controls.
- Provides PNG download and an SVG wrapper export. The current SVG export embeds a PNG image, so it should not be described as a true vector QR export.

## Scope and Identity

- Canonical name: MatrixQR.
- Main site: https://www.matrixqr.cc/
- MatrixQR refers to this privacy-focused QR utility and related MatrixQR sites, including the official blog and separate digital menu tool.
